1.he: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
1.en: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

1.he: לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה
1.en: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

1.he: לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים
1.en: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

1.he: לָתֵ֣ת לִפְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה לְ֝נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה
1.en: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:

1.he: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה
1.en: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:

1.he: לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְחִידֹתָֽם
1.en: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

1.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ
1.en: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

1.he: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ
1.en: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:

1.he: כִּ֤י לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ
1.en: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

1.he: בְּנִ֡י אִם יְפַתּ֥וּךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל תֹּבֵֽא
1.en: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

1.he: אִם יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם
1.en: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

1.he: נִ֭בְלָעֵם כִּשְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
1.en: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

1.he: כָּל ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל
1.en: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

1.he: גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּֽנוּ
1.en: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”

1.he: בְּנִ֗י אַל תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם
1.en: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

1.he: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם לָרַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִֽ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפָּךְ דָּֽם
1.en: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

1.he: כִּֽי חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י כָל בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף
1.en: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

1.he: וְ֭הֵם לְדָמָ֣ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם
1.en: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

1.he: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו יִקָּֽח
1.en: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

1.he: חָ֭כְמוֹת בַּח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ
1.en: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

1.he: בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּעִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ תֹאמֵֽר
1.en: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

1.he: עַד מָתַ֣י פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ דָֽעַת
1.en: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

1.he: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם
1.en: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

1.he: יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב
1.en: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

1.he: וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל עֲצָתִ֑י וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם
1.en: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

1.he: גַּם אֲ֭נִי בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּבֹ֣א פַחְדְּכֶֽם
1.en: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

1.he: בְּבֹ֤א כשאוהכשאוהכְשׁוֹאָ֨ה פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה
1.en: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

1.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי
1.en: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;

1.he: תַּ֭חַת כִּי שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ
1.en: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

1.he: לֹא אָב֥וּ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי
1.en: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

1.he: וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
1.en: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

1.he: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם
1.en: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

1.he: וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכָּן בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה
1.en: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

2.he: בְּ֭נִי אִם תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ
2.en: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

2.he: לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב לַֽחָכְמָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה
2.en: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

2.he: כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַבִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽךָ
2.en: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

2.he: אִם תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה
2.en: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:

2.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא
2.en: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.

2.he: כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה
2.en: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

2.he: וצפןוצפןיִצְפֹּ֣ןלַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם
2.en: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

2.he: לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חסידוחסידוחֲסִידָ֣יויִשְׁמֹֽר
2.en: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

2.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל מַעְגַּל טֽוֹב
2.en: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

2.he: כִּֽי תָב֣וֹא חָכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם
2.en: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

2.he: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה
2.en: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

2.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת
2.en: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

2.he: הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
2.en: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

2.he: הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע
2.en: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

2.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝נְלוֹזִ֗ים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם
2.en: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

2.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה
2.en: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

2.he: הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה
2.en: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

2.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְאֶל רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ
2.en: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

2.he: כָּל בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים
2.en: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

2.he: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים וְאָרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר
2.en: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

2.he: כִּֽי יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ
2.en: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

2.he: וּ֭רְשָׁעִים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽנָּה
2.en: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

3.he: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ
3.en: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:

3.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ
3.en: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

3.he: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ
3.en: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

3.he: וּמְצָא חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם
3.en: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

3.he: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל תִּשָּׁעֵֽן
3.en: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

3.he: בְּכָל דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ
3.en: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

3.he: אַל תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע
3.en: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

3.he: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ
3.en: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

3.he: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ
3.en: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:

3.he: וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ
3.en: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

3.he: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ
3.en: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

3.he: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה
3.en: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

3.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה
3.en: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

3.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ
3.en: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

3.he: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מפנייםמפנייםמִפְּנִינִ֑יםוְכָל חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽהּ
3.en: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

3.he: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד
3.en: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

3.he: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם
3.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

3.he: עֵץ חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר
3.en: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

3.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה
3.en: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

3.he: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ טָֽל
3.en: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

3.he: בְּ֭נִי אַל יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה
3.en: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

3.he: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ
3.en: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

3.he: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף
3.en: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

3.he: אִם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ
3.en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

3.he: אַל תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא
3.en: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

3.he: כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד
3.en: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

3.he: אַל תִּמְנַע ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל ידיךידיךיָדְךָ֣לַעֲשֽׂוֹת
3.en: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

3.he: אַל תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לרעיךלרעיךלְרֵֽעֲךָ֨ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ
3.en: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

3.he: אַל תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ
3.en: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

3.he: אַל תרובתרובתָּרִ֣יבעִם אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה
3.en: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

3.he: אַל תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל דְּרָכָֽיו
3.en: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

3.he: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ
3.en: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

3.he: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ
3.en: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

3.he: אִם לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא יָלִ֑יץ ולענייםולענייםוְ֝לַעֲנָוִ֗יםיִתֶּן חֵֽן
3.en: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

3.he: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן
3.en: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

4.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה
4.en: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

4.he: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ
4.en: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

4.he: כִּי בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי
4.en: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

4.he: וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה
4.en: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

4.he: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי פִֽי
4.en: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

4.he: אַל תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ
4.en: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

4.he: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה
4.en: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

4.he: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה
4.en: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

4.he: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ
4.en: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

4.he: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים
4.en: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

4.he: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי יֹֽשֶׁר
4.en: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

4.he: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל
4.en: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

4.he: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ
4.en: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

4.he: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים
4.en: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

4.he: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל תַּעֲבָר בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר
4.en: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

4.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם לֹ֥א יכשולויכשולויַכְשִֽׁילוּ
4.en: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

4.he: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ
4.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

4.he: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם
4.en: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

4.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ
4.en: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

4.he: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט אָזְנֶֽךָ
4.en: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

4.he: אַל יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ
4.en: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

4.he: כִּֽי חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא
4.en: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

4.he: מִֽכָּל מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים
4.en: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

4.he: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ
4.en: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

4.he: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ
4.en: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

4.he: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ
4.en: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

4.he: אַֽל תֵּט יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע
4.en: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

5.he: בְּ֭נִי לְחָכְמָתִ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לִ֝תְבוּנָתִ֗י הַט אָזְנֶֽךָ
5.en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

5.he: לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמּ֑וֹת וְ֝דַ֗עַת שְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ
5.en: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

5.he: כִּ֤י נֹ֣פֶת תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה וְחָלָ֖ק מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן חִכָּֽהּ
5.en: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

5.he: וְֽ֭אַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽלַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה כְּחֶ֣רֶב פִּיּֽוֹת
5.en: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

5.he: רַ֭גְלֶיהָ יֹרְד֣וֹת מָ֑וֶת שְׁ֝א֗וֹל צְעָדֶ֥יהָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ
5.en: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

5.he: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים פֶּן תְּפַלֵּ֑ס נָע֥וּ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗יהָ לֹ֣א תֵדָֽע
5.en: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

5.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י וְאַל תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי פִֽי
5.en: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

5.he: הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵעָלֶ֣יהָ דַרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְאַל תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽהּ
5.en: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

5.he: פֶּן תִּתֵּ֣ן לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וּ֝שְׁנֹתֶ֗יךָ לְאַכְזָרִֽי
5.en: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

5.he: פֶּֽן יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ זָרִ֣ים כֹּחֶ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲצָבֶ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית נָכְרִֽי
5.en: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

5.he: וְנָהַמְתָּ֥ בְאַחֲרִיתֶ֑ךָ בִּכְל֥וֹת בְּ֝שָׂרְךָ֗ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ
5.en: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

5.he: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר וְ֝תוֹכַ֗חַת נָאַ֥ץ לִבִּֽי
5.en: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

5.he: וְֽלֹא שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּק֣וֹל מוֹרָ֑י וְ֝לִֽמְלַמְּדַ֗י לֹא הִטִּ֥יתִי אָזְנִֽי
5.en: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

5.he: כִּ֭מְעַט הָיִ֣יתִי בְכָל רָ֑ע בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל וְעֵדָֽה
5.en: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

5.he: שְׁתֵה מַ֥יִם מִבּוֹרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝נֹזְלִ֗ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ בְּאֵרֶֽךָ
5.en: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

5.he: יָפ֣וּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶ֣יךָ ח֑וּצָה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת פַּלְגֵי מָֽיִם
5.en: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

5.he: יִֽהְיוּ לְךָ֥ לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֖ין לְזָרִ֣ים אִתָּֽךְ
5.en: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

5.he: יְהִֽי מְקוֹרְךָ֥ בָר֑וּךְ וּ֝שְׂמַ֗ח מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶֽךָ
5.en: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

5.he: אַיֶּ֥לֶת אֲהָבִ֗ים וְֽיַעֲלַ֫ת חֵ֥ן דַּ֭דֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּ֣ךָ בְכָל עֵ֑ת בְּ֝אַהֲבָתָ֗הּ תִּשְׁגֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד
5.en: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

5.he: וְלָ֤מָּה תִשְׁגֶּ֣ה בְנִ֣י בְזָרָ֑ה וּ֝תְחַבֵּ֗ק חֵ֣ק נָכְרִיָּֽה
5.en: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

5.he: כִּ֤י נֹ֨כַח עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל מַעְגְּלֹתָ֥יו מְפַלֵּֽס
5.en: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

5.he: עַֽווֹנוֹתָ֗יו יִלְכְּדֻנ֥וֹ אֶת הָרָשָׁ֑ע וּבְחַבְלֵ֥י חַ֝טָּאת֗וֹ יִתָּמֵֽךְ
5.en: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

5.he: ה֗וּא יָ֭מוּת בְּאֵ֣ין מוּסָ֑ר וּבְרֹ֖ב אִוַּלְתּ֣וֹ יִשְׁגֶּֽה
5.en: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

6.he: בְּ֭נִי אִם עָרַ֣בְתָּ לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ תָּקַ֖עְתָּ לַזָּ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ
6.en: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

6.he: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי פִ֑יךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי פִֽיךָ
6.en: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

6.he: עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את אֵפ֪וֹא בְּנִ֡י וְֽהִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ בְכַף רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּרְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽיךָ
6.en: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

6.he: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּ֝תְנוּמָ֗ה לְעַפְעַפֶּֽיךָ
6.en: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

6.he: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּצְבִ֣י מִיָּ֑ד וּ֝כְצִפּ֗וֹר מִיַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ
6.en: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

6.he: לֵֽךְ אֶל נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם
6.en: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

6.he: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין לָ֥הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּמֹשֵֽׁל
6.en: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

6.he: תָּכִ֣ין בַּקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָ֑הּ אָגְרָ֥ה בַ֝קָּצִ֗יר מַאֲכָלָֽהּ
6.en: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

6.he: עַד מָתַ֖י עָצֵ֥ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ
6.en: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

6.he: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב
6.en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

6.he: וּבָֽא כִמְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵאשֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹֽרְךָ֗ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן
6.en: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

6.he: אָדָ֣ם בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ אָ֑וֶן ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה
6.en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

6.he: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו
6.en: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

6.he: תַּֽהְפֻּכ֨וֹת בְּלִבּ֗וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּכָל עֵ֑ת מדניםמדניםמִדְיָנִ֥יםיְשַׁלֵּֽחַ
6.en: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

6.he: עַל כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא
6.en: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

6.he: שֶׁשׁ הֵ֭נָּה שָׂנֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝שֶׁ֗בַע תועבותתועבותתּוֹעֲבַ֥תנַפְשֽׁוֹ
6.en: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

6.he: עֵינַ֣יִם רָ֭מוֹת לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת דָּם נָקִֽי
6.en: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

6.he: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֑וֶן רַגְלַ֥יִם מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָר֥וּץ לָֽרָעָה
6.en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

6.he: יָפִ֣יחַ כְּ֭זָבִים עֵ֣ד שָׁ֑קֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים
6.en: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

6.he: נְצֹ֣ר בְּ֭נִי מִצְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ
6.en: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

6.he: קָשְׁרֵ֣ם עַל לִבְּךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד עָ֝נְדֵ֗ם עַל גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ
6.en: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

6.he: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ֨ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ךְ בְּֽ֭שָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑יךָ וַ֝הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ
6.en: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

6.he: כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר
6.en: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

6.he: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵ֣שֶׁת רָ֑ע מֵֽ֝חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה
6.en: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

6.he: אַל תַּחְמֹ֣ד יָ֭פְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל תִּ֝קָּֽחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ
6.en: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

6.he: כִּ֤י בְעַד אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה עַֽד כִּכַּ֫ר לָ֥חֶם וְאֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ נֶ֖פֶשׁ יְקָרָ֣ה תָצֽוּד
6.en: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

6.he: הֲיַחְתֶּ֤ה אִ֓ישׁ אֵ֬שׁ בְּחֵיק֑וֹ וּ֝בְגָדָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה
6.en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

6.he: אִם יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ אִ֭ישׁ עַל הַגֶּחָלִ֑ים וְ֝רַגְלָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה
6.en: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

6.he: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ
6.en: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

6.he: לֹא יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְמַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב
6.en: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;

6.he: וְ֭נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת כָּל ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ יִתֵּֽן
6.en: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

6.he: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר לֵ֑ב מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה
6.en: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

6.he: נֶֽגַע וְקָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝חֶרְפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה
6.en: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

6.he: כִּֽי קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת גָּ֑בֶר וְלֹֽא יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּי֣וֹם נָקָֽם
6.en: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

6.he: לֹא יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כָל כֹּ֑פֶר וְלֹֽא יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה שֹֽׁחַד
6.en: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

7.he: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ
7.en: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

7.he: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ
7.en: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

7.he: קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ
7.en: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

7.he: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭חָכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע לַבִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא
7.en: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

7.he: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה
7.en: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

7.he: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי
7.en: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

7.he: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר לֵֽב
7.en: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

7.he: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ יִצְעָֽד
7.en: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

7.he: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַאֲפֵלָֽה
7.en: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

7.he: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב
7.en: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

7.he: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְסֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ לֹא יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ
7.en: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

7.he: פַּ֤עַם בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת וְאֵ֖צֶל כָּל פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב
7.en: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

7.he: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ
7.en: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

7.he: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי
7.en: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

7.he: עַל כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ
7.en: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

7.he: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם
7.en: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

7.he: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן
7.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

7.he: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּאֳהָבִֽים
7.en: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

7.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָאִ֣ישׁ בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק
7.en: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

7.he: צְֽרוֹר הַ֭כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ
7.en: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

7.he: הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ
7.en: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

7.he: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר אֶל טָ֣בַח יָב֑וֹא וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל
7.en: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

7.he: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ כְּמַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל פָּ֑ח וְלֹֽא יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ הֽוּא
7.en: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

7.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי פִֽי
7.en: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

7.he: אַל יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ אַל תֵּ֝תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ
7.en: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

7.he: כִּֽי רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ
7.en: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

7.he: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל חַדְרֵי מָֽוֶת
7.en: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

8.he: הֲלֹֽא חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ
8.en: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

8.he: בְּרֹאשׁ מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה
8.en: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

8.he: לְיַד שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה
8.en: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

8.he: אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
8.en: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

8.he: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב
8.en: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

8.he: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים
8.en: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

8.he: כִּֽי אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑י וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י רֶֽשַׁע
8.en: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

8.he: בְּצֶ֥דֶק כָּל אִמְרֵי פִ֑י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ
8.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

8.he: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת
8.en: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

8.he: קְחֽוּ מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת מֵחָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר
8.en: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

8.he: כִּֽי טוֹבָ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽהּ
8.en: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

8.he: אֲֽנִי חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא
8.en: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

8.he: יִֽרְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְגָא֨וֹן וְדֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּפִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי
8.en: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

8.he: לִֽי עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה
8.en: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

8.he: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק
8.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

8.he: בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים כָּל שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק
8.en: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

8.he: אֲ֭נִי אהביהאהביהאֹהֲבַ֣יאֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי
8.en: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

8.he: עֹֽשֶׁר וְכָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּצְדָקָֽה
8.en: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

8.he: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִי מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י מִכֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר
8.en: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

8.he: בְּאֹֽרַח צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ך בְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
8.en: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

8.he: לְהַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥י יֵ֑שׁ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא
8.en: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

8.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז
8.en: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

8.he: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי אָֽרֶץ
8.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

8.he: בְּאֵין תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי מָֽיִם
8.en: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

8.he: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי
8.en: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

8.he: עַד לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל
8.en: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

8.he: בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּח֥וּקוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם
8.en: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

8.he: בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם
8.en: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

8.he: בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ לַיָּ֨ם חֻקּ֗וֹ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ
8.en: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

8.he: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְפָנָ֣יו בְּכָל עֵֽת
8.en: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

8.he: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
8.en: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

8.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ
8.en: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

8.he: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל תִּפְרָֽעוּ
8.en: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

8.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד עַל דַּ֭לְתֹתַי י֤וֹם י֑וֹם לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי
8.en: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

8.he: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי מצאימצאימָצָ֣אחַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה
8.en: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

8.he: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כָּל מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת
8.en: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

9.he: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ שִׁבְעָֽה
9.en: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

9.he: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ
9.en: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

9.he: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת
9.en: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

9.he: מִי פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ
9.en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

9.he: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי
9.en: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

9.he: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה
9.en: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

9.he: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ
9.en: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

9.he: אַל תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ
9.en: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

9.he: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח
9.en: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

9.he: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה
9.en: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

9.he: כִּי בִ֭י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים
9.en: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

9.he: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה
9.en: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

9.he: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת
9.en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

9.he: מִי פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ
9.en: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

9.he: מַֽיִם גְּנוּבִ֥ים יִמְתָּ֑קוּ וְלֶ֖חֶם סְתָרִ֣ים יִנְעָֽם
9.en: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

9.he: וְֽלֹא יָ֭דַע כִּֽי רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ
9.en: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

10.he: מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ
10.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

10.he: לֹא י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת
10.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

10.he: לֹֽא יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְהַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף
10.en: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

10.he: רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף רְמִיָּ֑ה וְיַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר
10.en: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

10.he: אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ
10.en: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

10.he: בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס
10.en: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

10.he: זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִבְרָכָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב
10.en: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

10.he: חֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט
10.en: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

10.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ
10.en: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

10.he: קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט
10.en: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

10.he: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס
10.en: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

10.he: שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעוֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְעַ֥ל כָּל פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה
10.en: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

10.he: בְּשִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו חֲסַר לֵֽב
10.en: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

10.he: חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ דָ֑עַת וּפִֽי אֱ֝וִיל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה
10.en: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

10.he: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁם
10.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

10.he: פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְחַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְחַטָּֽאת
10.en: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

10.he: אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה
10.en: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

10.he: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל
10.en: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

10.he: בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל פָּ֑שַׁע וְחֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל
10.en: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

10.he: כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט
10.en: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

10.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ
10.en: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

10.he: בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ
10.en: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

10.he: כִּשְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝חָכְמָ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה
10.en: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

10.he: מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
10.en: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

10.he: כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם
10.en: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

10.he: כַּחֹ֤מֶץ לַשִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְכֶעָשָׁ֥ן לָעֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝עָצֵ֗ל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו
10.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

10.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּשְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה
10.en: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

10.he: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
10.en: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

10.he: מָע֣וֹז לַ֭תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
10.en: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

10.he: צַדִּ֣יק לְעוֹלָ֣ם בַּל יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָֽרֶץ
10.en: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

10.he: פִּֽי צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חָכְמָ֑ה וּלְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת
10.en: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

10.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּן רָצ֑וֹן וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת
10.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

11.he: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ
11.en: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

11.he: בָּֽא זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה
11.en: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

11.he: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים ושדםושדםיְשָׁדֵּֽם
11.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

11.he: לֹא יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת
11.en: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

11.he: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע
11.en: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

11.he: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ
11.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

11.he: בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה
11.en: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

11.he: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו
11.en: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

11.he: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ
11.en: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

11.he: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה
11.en: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

11.he: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס
11.en: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

11.he: בָּז לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ
11.en: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

11.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר
11.en: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

11.he: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ
11.en: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

11.he: רַע יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ
11.en: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

11.he: אֵֽשֶׁת חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ עֹֽשֶׁר
11.en: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

11.he: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי
11.en: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

11.he: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת
11.en: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

11.he: כֵּן צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ
11.en: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

11.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ
11.en: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

11.he: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט
11.en: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

11.he: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם
11.en: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

11.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה
11.en: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

11.he: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר
11.en: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

11.he: נֶֽפֶשׁ בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא
11.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

11.he: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר
11.en: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

11.he: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ
11.en: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

11.he: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ
11.en: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

11.he: עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם לֵֽב
11.en: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

11.he: פְּֽרִי צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹת חָכָֽם
11.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

11.he: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא
11.en: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

12.he: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר
12.en: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

12.he: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ
12.en: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

12.he: לֹא יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
12.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

12.he: אֵֽשֶׁת חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה
12.en: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

12.he: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
12.en: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

12.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם
12.en: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

12.he: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד
12.en: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

12.he: לְֽפִי שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז
12.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

12.he: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר לָֽחֶם
12.en: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.

12.he: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי
12.en: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

12.he: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר לֵֽב
12.en: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

12.he: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
12.en: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

12.he: בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק
12.en: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

12.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי אָ֝דָ֗ם ישובישוביָשִׁ֥יבלֽוֹ
12.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

12.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם
12.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

12.he: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם
12.en: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

12.he: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
12.en: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

12.he: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא
12.en: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

12.he: שְֽׂפַת אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר
12.en: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

12.he: מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה
12.en: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

12.he: לֹא יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כָּל אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע
12.en: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

12.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ
12.en: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

12.he: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת
12.en: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

12.he: יַד חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס
12.en: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

12.he: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה
12.en: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

12.he: יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם
12.en: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

12.he: לֹא יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ
12.en: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

12.he: בְּאֹֽרַח צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל מָֽוֶת
12.en: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

13.he: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝לֵ֗ץ לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה
13.en: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

13.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יֹ֣אכַל ט֑וֹב וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בֹּגְדִ֣ים חָמָֽס
13.en: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

13.he: נֹצֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ פֹּשֵׂ֥ק שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מְחִתָּה לֽוֹ
13.en: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

13.he: מִתְאַוָּ֣ה וָ֭אַיִן נַפְשׁ֣וֹ עָצֵ֑ל וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ חָרֻצִ֣ים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן
13.en: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

13.he: דְּבַר שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר
13.en: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

13.he: צְ֭דָקָה תִּצֹּ֣ר תָּם דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ֝רִשְׁעָ֗ה תְּסַלֵּ֥ף חַטָּֽאת
13.en: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

13.he: יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭תְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל מִ֝תְרוֹשֵׁ֗שׁ וְה֣וֹן רָֽב
13.en: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

13.he: כֹּ֣פֶר נֶֽפֶשׁ אִ֣ישׁ עָשְׁר֑וֹ וְ֝רָ֗שׁ לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה
13.en: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

13.he: אוֹר צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְנֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ
13.en: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

13.he: רַק בְּ֭זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְאֶת נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חָכְמָֽה
13.en: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

13.he: ה֭וֹן מֵהֶ֣בֶל יִמְעָ֑ט וְקֹבֵ֖ץ עַל יָ֣ד יַרְבֶּֽה
13.en: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

13.he: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת מְ֭מֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה לֵ֑ב וְעֵ֥ץ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תַּאֲוָ֥ה בָאָֽה
13.en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

13.he: בָּ֣ז לְ֭דָבָר יֵחָ֣בֶל ל֑וֹ וִירֵ֥א מִ֝צְוָ֗ה ה֣וּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם
13.en: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

13.he: תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
13.en: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

13.he: שֵֽׂכֶל ט֭וֹב יִתֶּן חֵ֑ן וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֹּגְדִ֣ים אֵיתָֽן
13.en: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

13.he: כָּל עָ֭רוּם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְדָ֑עַת וּ֝כְסִ֗יל יִפְרֹ֥שׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת
13.en: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

13.he: מַלְאָ֣ךְ רָ֭שָׁע יִפֹּ֣ל בְּרָ֑ע וְצִ֖יר אֱמוּנִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא
13.en: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

13.he: רֵ֣ישׁ וְ֭קָלוֹן פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר וְשׁוֹמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יְכֻבָּֽד
13.en: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

13.he: תַּאֲוָ֣ה נִ֭הְיָה תֶּעֱרַ֣ב לְנָ֑פֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַ֥ת כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע
13.en: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

13.he: הלוךהלוךהוֹלֵ֣ךְאֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים וחכםוחכםיֶחְכָּ֑םוְרֹעֶ֖ה כְסִילִ֣ים יֵרֽוֹעַ
13.en: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

13.he: חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְאֶת צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם טֽוֹב
13.en: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

13.he: ט֗וֹב יַנְחִ֥יל בְּנֵֽי בָנִ֑ים וְצָפ֥וּן לַ֝צַּדִּ֗יק חֵ֣יל חוֹטֵֽא
13.en: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

13.he: רָב אֹ֭כֶל נִ֣יר רָאשִׁ֑ים וְיֵ֥שׁ נִ֝סְפֶּ֗ה בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט
13.en: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

13.he: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ שִׁ֭בְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵ֣א בְנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֹהֲב֗וֹ שִֽׁחֲר֥וֹ מוּסָֽר
13.en: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

13.he: צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֭כֵל לְשֹׂ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר
13.en: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

14.he: חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּיָדֶ֥יהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ
14.en: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

14.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭יָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּנְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣יו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ
14.en: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

14.he: בְּֽפִי אֱ֭וִיל חֹ֣טֶר גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽם
14.en: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

14.he: בְּאֵ֣ין אֲ֭לָפִים אֵב֣וּס בָּ֑ר וְרָב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּכֹ֣חַ שֽׁוֹר
14.en: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

14.he: עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר
14.en: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

14.he: בִּקֶּשׁ לֵ֣ץ חָכְמָ֣ה וָאָ֑יִן וְדַ֖עַת לְנָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל
14.en: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

14.he: לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭נֶּגֶד לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּבַל יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת
14.en: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

14.he: חָכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְאִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
14.en: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

14.he: אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּבֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן
14.en: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

14.he: לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מָרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בְשִׂמְחָת֗וֹ לֹא יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר
14.en: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

14.he: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ
14.en: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

14.he: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת
14.en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

14.he: גַּם בִּשְׂח֥וֹק יִכְאַב לֵ֑ב וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה תוּגָֽה
14.en: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

14.he: מִדְּרָכָ֣יו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵעָלָ֗יו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב
14.en: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

14.he: פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְכָל דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ
14.en: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

14.he: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ
14.en: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

14.he: קְֽצַר אַ֭פַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אִוֶּ֑לֶת וְאִ֥ישׁ מְ֝זִמּ֗וֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא
14.en: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

14.he: נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַֽ֝עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת
14.en: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

14.he: שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִפְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק
14.en: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

14.he: גַּם לְ֭רֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים
14.en: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

14.he: בָּז לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּמְחוֹנֵ֖ן ענייםענייםעֲנָוִ֣יםאַשְׁרָֽיו
14.en: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

14.he: הֲֽלוֹא יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב
14.en: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

14.he: בְּכָל עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר
14.en: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

14.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
14.en: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

14.he: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְיָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
14.en: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

14.he: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה
14.en: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

14.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
14.en: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

14.he: בְּרָב עָ֥ם הַדְרַת מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן
14.en: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

14.he: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
14.en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

14.he: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה
14.en: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

14.he: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן
14.en: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

14.he: בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק
14.en: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

14.he: בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ
14.en: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

14.he: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת
14.en: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

14.he: רְֽצוֹן מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ
14.en: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

15.he: מַֽעֲנֶה רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה אָֽף
15.en: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

15.he: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת
15.en: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.

15.he: בְּֽכָל מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים
15.en: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

15.he: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ
15.en: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

15.he: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם
15.en: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

15.he: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת
15.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

15.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא כֵֽן
15.en: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

15.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ
15.en: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

15.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב
15.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

15.he: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת
15.en: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.

15.he: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי אָדָֽם
15.en: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

15.he: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ
15.en: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

15.he: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה
15.en: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

15.he: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ דָּ֑עַת ופניופניוּפִ֥יכְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת
15.en: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

15.he: כָּל יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד
15.en: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

15.he: טוֹב מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ
15.en: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

15.he: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה בֽוֹ
15.en: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

15.he: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב
15.en: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

15.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה
15.en: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

15.he: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ
15.en: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

15.he: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר לָֽכֶת
15.en: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

15.he: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם
15.en: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

15.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה טּֽוֹב
15.en: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

15.he: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה
15.en: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

15.he: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה
15.en: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

15.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי נֹֽעַם
15.en: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

15.he: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה
15.en: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

15.he: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת
15.en: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

15.he: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע
15.en: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

15.he: מְֽאוֹר עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן עָֽצֶם
15.en: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

15.he: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין
15.en: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

15.he: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב
15.en: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

15.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה
15.en: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

16.he: לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן
16.en: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

16.he: כָּֽל דַּרְכֵי אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
16.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.

16.he: גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ
16.en: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

16.he: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה
16.en: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

16.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל גְּבַהּ לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
16.en: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.

16.he: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע
16.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

16.he: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ גַּם א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ
16.en: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

16.he: טוֹב מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט
16.en: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

16.he: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ
16.en: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

16.he: קֶ֤סֶם עַֽל שִׂפְתֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל פִּֽיו
16.en: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

16.he: פֶּ֤לֶס וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל אַבְנֵי כִֽיס
16.en: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

16.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא
16.en: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

16.he: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב
16.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

16.he: חֲמַת מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה
16.en: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

16.he: בְּאוֹר פְּנֵי מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ
16.en: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

16.he: קְֽנֹה חָכְמָ֗ה מַה טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף
16.en: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

16.he: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ
16.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

16.he: לִפְנֵי שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ
16.en: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

16.he: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל ר֭וּחַ אֶת ענייםענייםעֲנָוִ֑יםמֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת גֵּאִֽים
16.en: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

16.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו
16.en: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

16.he: לַחֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח
16.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

16.he: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
16.en: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

16.he: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח
16.en: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

16.he: צוּף דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם
16.en: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

16.he: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת
16.en: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

16.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ
16.en: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.

16.he: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל שפתיושפתיושְׂ֝פָת֗וֹכְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת
16.en: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

16.he: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ ןמַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף
16.en: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

16.he: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא טֽוֹב
16.en: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

16.he: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה
16.en: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

16.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא
16.en: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

16.he: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר
16.en: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

16.he: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ
16.en: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.

17.he: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי רִֽיב
17.en: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

17.he: עֶֽבֶד מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה
17.en: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

17.he: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
17.en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.

17.he: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל שְׂפַת אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת
17.en: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

17.he: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
17.en: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

17.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם
17.en: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.

17.he: לֹא נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת שָֽׁקֶר
17.en: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

17.he: אֶֽבֶן חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל
17.en: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

17.he: מְֽכַסֶּה פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף
17.en: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

17.he: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה
17.en: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

17.he: אַךְ מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח בּֽוֹ
17.en: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

17.he: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ
17.en: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

17.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא תמישתמישתָמ֥וּשׁרָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ
17.en: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

17.he: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ
17.en: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

17.he: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם
17.en: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

17.he: לָמָּה זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב אָֽיִן
17.en: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

17.he: בְּכָל עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד
